Description: Holdline complete ECS deployment in an existing VPC. Creates billable services; see aws/README.md.

PrivateSubnetIds.Description: Two private subnets in different AZs, with NAT or the required VPC endpoints

PublicSubnetIds.Description: Two public subnets in different AZs for the HTTPS load balancer

ImageUri.Description: ECR application image pinned by digest; publish for linux/amd64

CertificateArn.Description: Issued ACM certificate in this region covering DomainName

DomainName.Description: Public DNS name for the API

HostedZoneId.Description: Optional Route 53 public hosted zone; leave empty to manage DNS separately

ModelSecretArn.Description: Optional Secrets Manager JSON secret with OPENAI_API_KEY; never paste a key here

ModelName.Description: Optional provider model name; both model parameters are required for live wording

PostgresVersion.Description: PostgreSQL 17 minor version available in the deployment region

Properties.AlarmDescription: Inspect API dependency errors and service health
